title: L2 Grammar in Reading
instructions: 閱讀短文，依文法選出最適合填入空格的答案。
passage: Last summer, my class visited a small fishing village {{1}} most people still make a living from the sea. The villagers, {{2}} were very friendly, showed us how to repair fishing nets.
{{3}} the weather was hot, we worked for three hours without complaining. By the time we left, we {{4}} more than twenty nets. It was an experience {{5}} I will never forget.

questions.explain: 先行詞 village 是地點，關係副詞用 where（= in which）。
非限定關係子句（有逗號）不能用 that；指人、作主詞用 who。
後面接子句且語意為讓步，用連接詞 Although。Despite 與 Because of 後面要接名詞。
By the time + 過去式，主要子句用過去完成式 had repaired。
先行詞 experience 為事物，作 forget 的受詞，用 that（或 which）；what 不能有先行詞。
